import subprocess, sys, json
PY = sys.executable
def run(data, label):
    p = subprocess.run([PY, '/workspace/submission/main.py'], input=data, capture_output=True)
    out = p.stdout.decode('utf-8', 'replace')
    ok = (p.returncode == 0 and out.strip() == '{"error":"invalid-input"}')
    print(('OK  ' if ok else 'BAD '), label, '| rc=', p.returncode, '| out=', out[:80].replace('\n',' '), '| err=', p.stderr[:120].decode('utf-8','replace').replace('\n',' '))

run(b'', 'empty stdin')
run(b'   \n\t ', 'whitespace only')
run(b'null', 'null doc')
run(b'[]', 'array doc')
run(b'"x"', 'string doc')
run(b'123', 'number doc')
run(b'{}', 'empty object')
run(b'{"version":1}', 'missing keys')
run(b'{"version":1,"config":{},"model":{},"connections":[],"packets":[]}  ', 'trailing ws + bad sub')
run(b'{"version":1.0', 'truncated')
run(b'{"a":1,"a":2}', 'dup key top (invalid anyway)')
run(b'[1,2] [3]', 'two docs')
run(b'NaN', 'NaN')
run(b'Infinity', 'Infinity')
run(b'-Infinity', '-Infinity')
run(b'\xef\xbb\xbf{"version":1}', 'BOM')
run(b'\xff\xfe\x00bad', 'non-utf8')
run(b'{"version":true,"config":{},"model":{},"connections":[],"packets":[]}', 'bool version')
# deep nesting
run(b'[' * 200000 + b']' * 200000, 'deep nesting 200k')
run(b'{"a":' * 5000 + b'1' + b'}' * 5000, 'deep object nesting')
# oversized
big = b'{"version":1,"config":{},"model":{},"connections":[],"packets":[]}' + b' ' * (17*1024*1024)
run(big, 'oversized 17MiB padding')
# exactly 16MiB of valid-ish doc + padding
pad = 16*1024*1024 - 67
run(b'{"version":1,"config":{},"model":{},"connections":[],"packets":[]}' + b' ' * pad, 'exactly 16MiB (invalid content)')
# duplicate keys in a valid doc
doc = json.load(open('/workspace/examples/input.json'))
txt = json.dumps(doc)
i = txt.index('"slots"')
j = txt.index(',', i)
run((txt[:i] + txt[i:j] + ',' + txt[i:j] + txt[j:]).encode(), 'dup key slots in valid doc')
# float in valid doc
run(txt.replace('"slots": 2', '"slots": 2.0').encode(), 'float slots')
run(txt.replace('"slots": 2', '"slots": 02').encode(), 'leading zero int')
run(txt.replace('"time": 0', '"time": 1e2').encode(), 'exponent number')
# non-ASCII id
d2 = json.loads(txt); d2['connections'][0]['id'] = 'é'; run(json.dumps(d2).encode(), 'non-ascii id')
d3 = json.loads(txt); d3['connections'][0]['id'] = 'a'*33; run(json.dumps(d3).encode(), 'id too long')
d4 = json.loads(txt); d4['packets'][0]['connection'] = 'zzz'; run(json.dumps(d4).encode(), 'unknown connection')
d5 = json.loads(txt); d5['packets'][1]['time'] = 0; run(json.dumps(d5).encode(), 'decreasing time')
